metadata.cwe_name: Improper Privilege Management

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Privilege Management
to_analyzer.description: The product does not properly assign, modify, track, or check privileges for an actor, creating an unintended sphere of control for that actor.

metadata.cwe_name: Divide By Zero

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Divide By Zero
to_analyzer.description: The product divides a value by zero.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
to_analyzer.description: The product constructs all or part of an OS command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended OS command when it is sent to a downstream component.

metadata.cwe_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity
to_analyzer.description: The product uses a regular expression with an inefficient, possibly exponential worst-case computational complexity that consumes excessive CPU cycles.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
to_analyzer.description: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory, but the product does not properly neutralize special elements within the pathname that can cause the pathname to resolve to a location that is outside of the restricted directory.

metadata.cwe_name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information

metadata.cwe_name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)

to_analyzer.description: The product compares two entities in a security-relevant context, but the comparison is incorrect, which may lead to resultant weaknesses.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
to_analyzer.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
to_analyzer.description: The product constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended SQL command when it is sent to a downstream component. Without sufficient removal or quoting of SQL syntax in user-controllable inputs, the generated SQL query can cause those inputs to be interpreted as SQL instead of ordinary user data.

metadata.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes
to_analyzer.description: The product receives input from an upstream component that specifies multiple attributes, properties, or fields that are to be initialized or updated in an object, but it does not properly control which attributes can be modified.

metadata.cwe_name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
to_analyzer.description: The web server receives a URL or similar request from an upstream component and retrieves the contents of this URL, but it does not sufficiently ensure that the request is being sent to the expected destination.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
to_analyzer.description: The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the syntax or behavior of the intended code segment.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')
to_analyzer.description: The product receives input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes code syntax before using the input in a dynamic evaluation call (e.g. "eval").

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
to_analyzer.description: The product prepares a structured message for communication with another component, but encoding or escaping of the data is either missing or done incorrectly. As a result, the intended structure of the message is not preserved.

metadata.cwe_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity
to_analyzer.description: The product uses a regular expression with an inefficient, possibly exponential worst-case computational complexity that consumes excessive CPU cycles.

metadata.cwe_name: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String

metadata.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

to_analyzer.description: A web application accepts a user-controlled input that specifies a link to an external site, and uses that link in a Redirect. This simplifies phishing attacks.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Initialization

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Initialization
to_analyzer.description: The product does not initialize or incorrectly initializes a resource, which might leave the resource in an unexpected state when it is accessed or used.

metadata.cwe_name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
to_analyzer.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
to_analyzer.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

metadata.cwe_name: Misinterpretation of Input

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Misinterpretation of Input
to_analyzer.description: The product misinterprets an input, whether from an attacker or another product, in a security-relevant fashion.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
to_analyzer.description: The product prepares a structured message for communication with another component, but encoding or escaping of the data is either missing or done incorrectly. As a result, the intended structure of the message is not preserved.

metadata.cwe_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity
to_analyzer.description: The product uses a regular expression with an inefficient, possibly exponential worst-case computational complexity that consumes excessive CPU cycles.

metadata.cwe_name: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String
to_analyzer.description: The product uses a function that accepts a format string as an argument, but the format string originates from an external source.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
to_analyzer.description: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory, but the product does not properly neutralize special elements within the pathname that can cause the pathname to resolve to a location that is outside of the restricted directory.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Authentication

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Authentication
to_analyzer.description: When an actor claims to have a given identity, the product does not prove or insufficiently proves that the claim is correct.

to_analyzer.description: A heap overflow condition is a buffer overflow, where the buffer that can be overwritten is allocated in the heap portion of memory, generally meaning that the buffer was allocated using a routine such as malloc().

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Input Validation
to_analyzer.description:
The product receives input or data, but it does
        not validate or incorrectly validates that the input has the
        properties that are required to process the data safely and
        correctly.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
to_analyzer.description: The product performs operations on a memory buffer, but it reads from or writes to a memory location outside the buffer's intended boundary. This may result in read or write operations on unexpected memory locations that could be linked to other variables, data structures, or internal program data.

metadata.cwe_name: Double Free

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Double Free
to_analyzer.description: The product calls free() twice on the same memory address, potentially leading to modification of unexpected memory locations.

metadata.cwe_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity
to_analyzer.description: The product uses a regular expression with an inefficient, possibly exponential worst-case computational complexity that consumes excessive CPU cycles.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
to_analyzer.description: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory, but the product does not properly neutralize special elements within the pathname that can cause the pathname to resolve to a location that is outside of the restricted directory.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
to_analyzer.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

metadata.cwe_name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
to_analyzer.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.

metadata.cwe_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity
to_analyzer.description: The product uses a regular expression with an inefficient, possibly exponential worst-case computational complexity that consumes excessive CPU cycles.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Escape, Meta, or Control Sequences

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Neutralization of Escape, Meta, or Control Sequences
to_analyzer.description: The product receives input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could be interpreted as escape, meta, or control character sequences when they are sent to a downstream component.

metadata.cwe_name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
to_analyzer.description: The web application does not, or can not, sufficiently verify whether a well-formed, valid, consistent request was intentionally provided by the user who submitted the request.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
to_analyzer.description: The product constructs all or part of an OS command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended OS command when it is sent to a downstream component.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

to_analyzer.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

metadata.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
to_analyzer.description: The product constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended SQL command when it is sent to a downstream component. Without sufficient removal or quoting of SQL syntax in user-controllable inputs, the generated SQL query can cause those inputs to be interpreted as SQL instead of ordinary user data.

metadata.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes
to_analyzer.description: The product receives input from an upstream component that specifies multiple attributes, properties, or fields that are to be initialized or updated in an object, but it does not properly control which attributes can be modified.

metadata.cwe_name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

to_analyzer.vulnerability_name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
to_analyzer.description: The web server receives a URL or similar request from an upstream component and retrieves the contents of this URL, but it does not sufficiently ensure that the request is being sent to the expected destination.
